author: ArionPay
description: Create crypto invoices (Bitcoin, USDT, Litecoin, Ethereum, TRON and more), send customers to the ArionPay payment page, and verify signed webhooks. Payments go straight to your own wallet. Standard library only; works with Rails, Sinatra, Hanami and any Rack app.
